title: Compact-support exchange through all specified coefficient domains
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/(\varpi^n)$ for $n\ge1$. Use [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Let $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $g':X'\to X$, $f':X'\to Y'$ be a Cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] of separated finite-type $k$-schemes and separated finite-type $k$-morphisms. Choose a compactification $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow\overline X,p:\overline X\to Y)$ with $j$ quasi-compact open and $p$ proper, and its base change $c'=(j',p')$ [def-nagata-compactification]. Use the compactification exchange of [def-exchange-projection]. For bounded finite torsion etale $K$, extension by zero is still bounded below with the same annihilating coefficient ring; the composite
$$Lg^*Rp_*j_!K\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Ex}_{*,p}}Rp'_*L\bar g'^*j_!K\xrightarrow{Rp'_*(\beta_K)}Rp'_*j'_!Lg'^*K$$
is an isomorphism, agrees under the canonical proper/open refinement comparisons, and defines the compactification-independent exchange. For a finite pro-etale input equipped with a bounded etale-origin witness [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], the transported compactification composite is the etale composite conjugated by that witness; it is invertible and independent of the witness.
At $R$, use derived-complete constructible inputs with compatible etale-origin reductions in a common finite interval [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete] and completed pullback [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. The specified completed exchange is completed proper exchange on $j_!K$, followed by the completed open comparison; it is invertible and compactification independent. At $E$ use a specified integral lattice presentation and raw rationalization; at $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ use admissible common-stage presentations stable under common finite overfields. Retain the uniform landing bounds of [thm-cbc-complete-proetale, thm-cbc-finite-extension, thm-cbc-qbar] whenever asserting the conclusion in $D^b_c$. The rational exchange is the extension of the completed one, is natural for rational morphisms and independent of the lattice; the common-stage exchange is represented by that finite-stage map after a finite overfield and is independent of the field and representative. These are exactly the compact-support theorem maps. No smoothness of $g$ is required.

The route follows main-20261015 prop-functor-package.proof clause (4): thm-cbc-finite-torsion, thm-cbc-qbar and thm-weil-pbc-bounded-below. The deliberate non-identification with the condensed categories of the latest blueprint is correct, and no target is weakened. I checked Stacks 0F7L (the compactification composite of proper base change on j_! followed by extension-by-zero base change) and 03DJ (j_! exact). No SGA source is used. Step checks: (1) lem-pur-finite-setting-comparison-hypotheses gives Noetherian, finite-dimensional corners with ℓ invertible, which covers the hypotheses of the later theorems; j_! keeps the lower bound and the ℓ^n annihilator. (2) The square (p, ḡ′, g, p′) is cartesian, thm-weil-pbc-bounded-below applies to the forgetful image, lem-weil-pbc-exchange-forget-coefficients(3) reflects invertibility, and β is invertible by cor-cbc-derived-extension-zero-base-change. This is redundant with thm-cbc-finite-torsion but not a fault. (3) thm-cbc-finite-torsion gives refinement and compactification independence; def-cbc-exchange-map and def-exchange-projection have the same ordered composite. (4) thm-cbc-finite-level-proetale applies with c given; I checked the directions in the α-conjugation. (5) def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete supplies exactly the hypotheses of thm-cbc-complete-proetale; (O_E,(ϖ)) is an adic datum (P_n finite and perfect). (6) Lattice independence and naturality come from thm-cbc-finite-extension; compactification independence comes from prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport, which extends the transformations and their equations uniquely. (7) thm-cbc-qbar gives representation and independence, and prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors descends the equations. Edge cases K=0, j=id, g=id, empty X and n=1 are consistent, and g is never assumed smooth. All 15 cited nodes are live, unmerged and unchanged, and no duplicate exists in the DAG. No fixes.
